critique: Both frames clearly read as a pale pastel-blue particle plane on clean black, with restrained organic evolution from t1 to t4 and no intrusive foreground bokeh. The main remaining mismatch is surface quality: particles remain individually sharp and granular instead of merging into a softly radiant magical sheet. At t4, the center also develops a thicker downward underside that weakens the intended refined thin-horizon silhouette.

suggestions.why: Increase particle feathering so the resolved dots blend into a more cohesive, luminous ethereal surface without reintroducing large foreground discs.
Reduce field influence on particle position to restrain the t4 center sag and preserve a thinner, more controlled planar horizon.
